sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-10c"
sources.quote: Kepler-10c is an exoplanet orbiting the G-type star Kepler-10, located around 608 light-years away in Draco.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around Kepler-10. Its orbit and size follow Dumusque et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-10c"
sources.quote: Its discovery was announced by the Kepler space telescope team in May 2011, although it had been seen as a planetary candidate since January 2011, when Kepler-10b was discovered.
